A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose an efficient method to estimate OCR accuracy for mobile-captured images, and to detect images which are not suitable for OCR processing.
we have developed an algorithm to detect out-of-focus blur, which is fast, reliable, and easy to integrate in an existing mobile OCR application.
we provide a new way to improve OCR performance for mobile-captured documents, which can be implemented in a mobile device, with no need to train a classifier.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of focus measures is a promising way to detect blur and predict OCR accuracy in mobile document images.
a combination of fast focus measures is a good alternative to a deep neural network, for the estimation of OCR accuracy on mobile-captured document image.
a combination of focus measures, which is simple to implement, can predict OCR accuracy in a mobile environment.
